metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in the United Kingdom increase in February 11-25, 2019 compared to the same period average from 2000-2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) for the UK. Use MODIS/006/MOD11A1 (daily 1-km) collection. Periods: Feb 11-25 for 2019 vs 2000-2012. 2. Masking strategy: Use the built-in QC-quality band to mask unreliable pixels (keep only “good”/“ok” quality). 3. Logic: Compute spatial mean LST over UK for each period, then compare 2019 value vs 2000-2012 mean. - If any collection is empty → C1. - If after masking there are 0 valid pixels → C2. - If any computed mean is None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise, if 2019 > historical → A, else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # Geometry: approximate UK bounding box uk = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-8.2, 49.8, 1.8, 60.9]) # Dates feb11_25 = ['--02-11', '--02-25'] def get_col(years): col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') \ .filterBounds(uk) \ .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(42, 56)) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(years[0], years[1], 'year')) \ .select('LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day') valid = col.map(lambda img: img.select('LST_Day_1km') \ .updateMask(img.select('QC_Day').lt(3))) # keep good/ok return valid hist = get_col([2000, 2012]) cur = get_col([2019, 2019]) if hist.size().getInfo() == 0 or cur.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No data for one period.") print("C1") def mean_lst(col): img = col.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15) # scale & K→C cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=uk, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km') val = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=uk, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km') return val.getInfo(), cnt.getInfo() l_h, c_h = mean_lst(hist) l_c, c_c = mean_lst(cur) if c_h == 0 or c_c == 0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") if l_h is None or l_c is None: print("C3") print(f"2000-12 mean: {l_h:.2f}°C, pixels: {c_h}") print(f"2019 mean: {l_c:.2f}°C, pixels: {c_c}") print("A" if l_c > l_h else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Geometry: approximate UK bounding box
uk = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-8.2, 49.8, 1.8, 60.9])

# Dates
feb11_25 = ['--02-11', '--02-25']

def get_col(years):
    col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') \
            .filterBounds(uk) \
            .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(42, 56)) \
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(years[0], years[1], 'year')) \
            .select('LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day')
    valid = col.map(lambda img: img.select('LST_Day_1km') \
                    .updateMask(img.select('QC_Day').lt(3)))  # keep good/ok
    return valid

hist = get_col([2000, 2012])
cur  = get_col([2019, 2019])

if hist.size().getInfo() == 0 or cur.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No data for one period.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

def mean_lst(col):
    img = col.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)  # scale & K→C
    cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=uk, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km')
    val = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=uk, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km')
    return val.getInfo(), cnt.getInfo()

l_h, c_h = mean_lst(hist)
l_c, c_c = mean_lst(cur)

if c_h == 0 or c_c == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

if l_h is None or l_c is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

print(f"2000-12 mean: {l_h:.2f}°C, pixels: {c_h}")
print(f"2019 mean: {l_c:.2f}°C, pixels: {c_c}")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if l_c > l_h else "<answer>B</answer>")
